author: kuro68k

judgment.rationale: The report contains current paths, multiple diagnostics, configuration outcomes, and a partial refresh workaround that narrow the owning All Apps pipeline.
evidence: The common Start Menu LibreOffice .lnk is explicitly identified.
Manual All Apps searching refreshes some Chrome PWA shortcuts, while restart alone does not fix LibreOffice.
judgment.recommended_action: Design deterministic shortcut rejection diagnostics and a full rescan/invalidation path for All Apps.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing upstream fix attempt references this issue; the active module rewrite does not yet cover the reported cases.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette's All Apps source omits valid Start Menu shortcuts such as LibreOffice and some Chrome-installed apps, while some indexed apps can appear but fail to launch.
known_information: LibreOffice Writer is present at the common Start Menu path and remains missing after Command Palette restarts.
Three diagnostic archives were supplied across PowerToys 0.97.2 and later builds.
PATH discovery restored Kitty, while LibreOffice remained absent; manually searching missing Chrome apps through the All Apps menu refreshed some entries.
inferences: There are at least two paths: source settings explain PATH apps, while stale or rejected Start Menu shortcut entries explain LibreOffice/Chrome.
The manual refresh recovery points to cache/watcher invalidation in addition to shortcut parsing.
issue_context.analysis: The current All Apps implementation watches Start Menu trees, resolves .lnk targets, filters invalid/non-app shortcuts, and retains an in-memory repository. The supplied path and repeat diagnostics are enough to design logging and deterministic refresh around shortcut rejection and cache invalidation rather than ask for another generic package.
initial_investigation: src/modules/cmdpal/ext/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.Apps/Programs/Win32Program.cs rejects unresolved/nonexistent .lnk targets and classifies generic targets according to settings.
Win32ProgramRepository relies on file-system watcher events and a background queue to refresh changed shortcuts.
No pull request referencing issue 45913 was found.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Start the bounded fork-side design workflow. This draft performs no upstream write.

actions.label: E
actions.note: Local maintainer verification only; no GitHub write is performed.

proposed_fixes.title: Make All Apps shortcut indexing complete and self-healing
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Start Menu .lnk entries can be dropped during target resolution/classification or remain absent after watcher/cache drift; the current UI does not expose why an entry was rejected or guarantee a complete rebuild.
plan: Record a structured acceptance/rejection reason for every Start Menu shortcut, including resolved target, arguments, app type, and enabled-source decision.
Make manual refresh and relevant settings changes rebuild the repository from all configured sources rather than depend on watcher history.
Add fixtures for LibreOffice multi-shortcut targets, Chrome PWAs, and argument-bearing shortcuts, preserving distinct identities and launch commands.
verification: Install LibreOffice and representative Chrome PWAs, rebuild All Apps, and verify every enabled Start Menu shortcut appears and launches across restart and upgrade.

confidence.rationale: The refresh behavior and current shortcut pipeline strongly identify the subsystem, but diagnostics are still needed to tell rejection from stale-cache loss for LibreOffice.
